Do not browse, use outside facts, create keyword IDs or label a merely cited/example/background task as the paper's contribution. Apply each vocabulary definition. A parent is not automatically present because a child was chosen. Missing abstract is allowed; use title evidence conservatively. An empty keyword list is a valid completed result.

Return JSON: {"paper_id":string,"input_sha256":string,"keyword_ids":[string],"evidence":[{"keyword_id":string,"field":"title"|"abstract","quote":string}]}. Every chosen ID must have at least one literal continuous quote from the given field. No invented quotes, scores or extra prose. Model/provider/settings and prompt hashes are logged by the runner, not invented in this output.
